business_problem: Healthcare technology provider eClinicalWorks sought to improve efficiency and cut time spent for healthcare workers who had to go through thousands of faxes each year to match the faxed data with current patient files.
solution_summary: Healthcare technology provider eClinicalWorks sought to improve efficiency and cut time spent for healthcare workers who had to go through thousands of faxes each year to match the faxed data with current patient files. The company developed a tool using Azure AI Services and Azure AI Document Intelligence to scan and sort through thousands of faxes using advanced machine learning. This tool analyzes and matches each fax to simplify the process for healthcare workers. Artificial intelligence is augmenting the workflows and making things more efficient so that providers and staff can do what they really love to do—take care of patients. In many healthcare practices and facilities, physicians and staff spend hours each day sorting through paper documentation related to patient health records. This keeps them from spending as much time with patients as they would like and leads to feelings of burnout.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Document Intelligence
solution_components.role: Extracts structured fields and text from forms or document images to reduce manual processing.

solution_components.name: Azure AI Services
solution_components.role: Supplies language, vision, and other AI APIs that classify, interpret, or enrich source content.

data_flow: Incoming faxed documents are analyzed with Azure AI Document Intelligence and Azure AI Services, matched to the right records, and then surfaced back to healthcare staff through the operational workflow.
business_outcome: Moving toward increased provider and patient satisfaction with AI tools
metrics: Today, eClinicalWorks serves over 180,000 providers and 1 million medical professionals with the latest innovations in cloud-based and AI-driven electronic health records and practice management solutions.
“We’ve worked with Microsoft for over 10 years,” says Bharat Satyanarayan, Vice President of Technology and Quality Assurance at eClinicalWorks.
So far, 427 practices have implemented this solution and scanned nearly 2.2 million faxes, saving up to one minute per incoming fax.
eClinicalWorks has helped healthcare providers reduce time spent on paperwork and spend more time with patients by using AI to improve efficiency and analyze nearly 2.2 million faxes.
